note: Re-judged 2026-10-20 (independent judge, after d6e44c3bb1). Section 5.2 step 3b: "(No SAs are created in response to receipt of a packet that requires IPsec protection; only BYPASS or DISCARD cache entries can be created this way.) If there is no match, discard the traffic." Same producer walk as RFC4301-5.2-1. The only cited producer that moved is warnSPDLeft: d6e44c3bb1 changed its warning text alone (exact `ip xfrm policy delete` command per leftover entry); it still returns true iff the ledger is non-empty and releaseSPD still keeps the catch-all then. The unmatched-traffic paths are unchanged: VPP runs only under `unmatched bypass` with no catch-all (vppPolicyInterface, ErrNoNodeWideSPD), and the OSPFv3 RFC 4552 manual-key entries (defaultDataplaneSource) have no catch-all, so traffic matching no entry there is delivered, not discarded. Named tests pass at HEAD (TestReleaseSPDKeepsTheCatchAllWhenARemovalFails, TestRFC4301FinalEntryIsUnderEveryZeSPDEntry, TestRunInstallsNoSPDEntryBeforeTheFirstApply, TestUnmatched*). Gap stands; {gap} annotation accurate.
